items.t: Automatic transmission slipping, failure or stuck in one gear
items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A local rebuild or a used unit can cost less. Check fluid type and level first, since wrong fluid causes some problems.

items.t: Fuel leak from fuel rail O-rings
items.job: Replace fuel rail O-rings
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Fuel leak where the fuel pump mounts to the tank
items.job: Drop fuel tank and replace fuel pump module seal
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Front lower control arm bolt can break
items.job: Replace front lower control arm bolts
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Radio short circuit can start a speaker fire
items.job: Inspect radio and install fused wiring repair
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank control valve weld can leak
items.job: Replace fuel tank
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Power steering cooler hose can split
items.job: Replace power steering cooler hose
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Power liftgate latch may not lock
items.job: Replace power liftgate latch
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Front passenger seat belt retractor may be assembled wrong
items.job: Replace front passenger seat belt retractor
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Harsh shifting, slipping or limp mode from the six-speed automatic
items.job: Replace transmission solenoid pack and update software
items.note: If clutches are burned and the transmission needs a rebuild, expect much more.

items.t: Transmission pump can seize and cause loss of drive
items.job: Replace transmission
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Integrated power module (TIPM) failure
items.job: Replace and program integrated power module (TIPM)
items.note: Rebuilt modules or a rebuild service for your own unit cost less.

items.t: Ignition key can slip out of Run and shut off the engine
items.job: Replace ignition switch and key ring per recall
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: A/C water can drip on the air bag module
items.job: Install A/C drain shield, replace air bag module if damaged
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Air bag control unit can corrode and fail
items.job: Replace air bag control module
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Steering wheel emblem can break loose in an air bag deployment
items.job: Replace driver air bag cover or module
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Driver door vent window switch can overheat
items.job: Replace vent window switch and add jumper harness
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Steering column rivet may be missing
items.job: Inspect and replace steering column if needed
items.note: Most vans only need an inspection. Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Misfires from a failing left cylinder head
items.job: Replace left cylinder head (3.6L Pentastar)
items.note: Many affected vans got an extended head warranty. Check your VIN or ask the dealer before paying.

items.t: Ticking engine from worn rocker arms
items.job: Replace rocker arms and lash adjusters, both banks
items.note: If camshafts are worn too, expect more.

items.t: Debris in the engine can ruin rod bearings
items.job: Replace engine (3.6L Pentastar)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Right rear wheel hub may not be fully machined
items.job: Replace right rear wheel hub and bearing
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Air bag software can deploy the wrong air bags
items.job: Air bag control module software update
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Tire pressure monitor may not warn of low tires
items.job: Tire pressure monitor software update
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Blind spot monitoring stops working
items.job: Replace blind spot sensor module
items.note: Price is per side. Check wiring and connectors first, since they sometimes cause the fault.
